name: Paperspace Core - A100-80G
price_basis: per A100-80G instance-hour, on-demand, including 12 vCPU + 90 GB RAM. Fetched 2026-10-04. The 'A100-80G' naming is ambiguous - this is likely the PCIe variant, not SXM. Multi-GPU types available (8x).
notes: Paperspace A100-80G at $1.15/hr is the cheapest published A100 rate found in this research. It is 57% below CoreWeave on-demand A100 ($2.70), 72% below AWS p4d ($4.10), and 77% below Replicate ($5.04). However, the 'A100-80G' naming is ambiguous - Paperspace does not specify whether this is the PCIe or SXM variant. Given the price point, it is almost certainly the PCIe variant. The rate includes 12 vCPU and 90GB RAM. Paperspace enforces auto-shutdown (12h limit on Free tier, configurable on paid tiers). Paperspace was acquired by DigitalOcean.
